legal.privacyPolicy:
Data Controller: Adrián Carrasco López. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Purpose: management of wedding invitations, confirmation of attendance, and communication of events.

Legal basis: consent of the data subject (Art. 6.1.a GDPR). Health data (allergies and food intolerances) is processed with explicit consent (Art. 9.2.a GDPR) to adapt the celebration menu.

Data collected: Expected guest list: the organizer may add a list of names (expected guests) for attendance control; this data is visible only to the organizer and follows the same retention policy. Demonstrable consent: RSVP consent and cookie preferences are recorded with date and policy version. Access and audit: for security and traceability purposes (legitimate interest), attempts to access the organizer panel and configuration changes (date, type of action, and technical device data) are recorded. name, dietary preferences (allergies and intolerances), voluntarily uploaded images, bank details if voluntarily provided, date of birth (only to validate age in RSVP for minors), technical browser data (user-agent) upon confirming attendance, and, if you participate in the social functions of the invitation (dedications, songs, itineraries, gift reservations), your name and the message you provide, which are VISIBLE to the rest of the guests.

Recipients: Google LLC (Firebase, Google Cloud Platform) based in the US. Google has subscribed to the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission (Decision 2021/914) and has a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with Art. 28 GDPR. Furthermore, Google complies with the EU-US, UK-US, and Switzerland-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF), a certification that guarantees an adequate level of protection for international data transfers.

International transfers: data is stored on Google Cloud servers in the eur3 region (Europe, Frankfurt). When data needs to be transferred to the US, the transfer is covered by the SCC and Google's DPF certification.

Retention period: guest data is retained for up to 12 months after the event date. After this period, guest data is deleted by the service administrator (who has a cleanup function in their panel) and, in any case, is not kept for more than 12 months. You can also request early deletion. You can request early deletion at any time by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. Creator configuration data is retained for up to 12 months after the event date or as long as the account is active, whichever comes first; its deletion is executed by the service administrator.

Rights: you can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, limitation, portability, and objection by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. Guests can request the deletion of their data by indicating their name and the invitation. We will respond to your request within a maximum period of 30 days.

Right to withdraw consent: you can withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal will not affect the lawfulness of processing based on prior consent.

Minors: we do not knowingly collect data from minors under 14 years of age. If the data subject is under 14 years of age (or the equivalent age according to the country of residence: 14 in Spain, 16 in Germany, etc.), the consent of their parents or legal guardians is required.

Automated decisions: no automated decisions are made based on your data.

Consequences of not providing data: if you do not provide your personal data, we will not be able to manage your confirmation of attendance.

DPO: this website does not require a Data Protection Officer according to Art. 37 GDPR as the conditions of Art. 37.1 are not met. However, you can contact the controller at any time.

GDPR Complaints (EU/EEA): you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) or with the supervisory authority of your EU member country.

UK GDPR: for residents in the United Kingdom, the data controller commits to complying with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Google complies with the EU-US DPF UK Extension, and the SCC have been adopted by the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) as a valid transfer mechanism. You can file a complaint with the ICO (https://ico.org.uk).

LGPD (Brazil): for residents in Brazil, the data controller commits to complying with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD – Law No. 13.709/2018). Google complies with the requirements for international transfer of LGPD. DPO: same controller. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Rights according to Art. 18 LGPD: confirmation, access, correction, anonymization/blocking/erasure, portability, information on sharing, withdrawal of consent, review of automated decisions, objection.

CCPA/CPRA (California): for residents in California (US), you have the right to:
- Know what categories of personal data we collect and for what purpose.
- Request the deletion of your personal data.
- Opt out of the sale of your personal data (we do not sell personal data).
- Not be discriminated against for exercising your CCPA rights.
To exercise these rights, write to adriancl2001@gmail.com.

PIPEDA (Canada): for residents in Canada, we comply with the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act. PIPEDA Principles: accountability (Adrián Carrasco López), identification of purposes, consent, limitation of collection, limitation of use/disclosure/retention, accuracy, safeguards, transparency, individual access, possibility of complaint. Mandatory breach notification to the OPC.

POPIA (South Africa): for residents in South Africa, we comply with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). We collect your data with your consent for specific purposes. Conditions for cross-border transfers (Section 72 POPIA): data is transferred to Google LLC (US) which offers an adequate level of protection through SCC and DPF. The controller guarantees that the recipient applies processing principles similar to POPIA. You can file a complaint with the Information Regulator (South Africa).

Security breach response plan: in case of personal data breach, Wedingo will notify the competent supervisory authority within a maximum period of 72 hours (GDPR Art. 33). If the breach poses a high risk to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects, they will be notified without undue delay (GDPR Art. 34). Notifications will be made by email to the provided contact address.

Local storage: this site uses local storage. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers without your consent or action: the map and translation only activate when clicked. Local storage: this site uses local storage (localStorage and sessionStorage) only for essential functions: keeping your session logged in and caching the invitation configuration. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers. By continuing to browse, you consent to the use of this necessary technical storage.

Technical storage and cache (PWA): Wedingo uses a service worker (/sw.js) that pre-caches application resources (JavaScript, CSS, and fonts) to speed up loading and allow basic offline use. These resources are stored in the device's browser cache and do not contain your personal data. You can clear this cache from your browser settings at any time.

Analytics and error monitoring: with your consent (Statistics option), Wedingo uses Google Analytics (Google LLC) to measure the anonymous use of the invitation and Sentry (Functional Software, Inc., with DPA and Standard Contractual Clauses) to detect and correct errors. These services only receive data if you accept this option in the cookie banner; they are not activated without consent. Furthermore, if the invitation includes a map, the Google Maps view loads only when clicked (load on click): the map may issue Google cookies only at that moment and by your action.

Translation: the 'Translate' function uses the free Google widget (Google LLC) and only activates if the user requests it; the invitation text is sent to Google only at that moment (processor covered by SCC and DPF). Optional contact: if the guest authorizes it (specific checkbox), their phone or email is saved only for event logistics and is only visible to the organizer; it can be requested for deletion at any time.

legal.cookiesPolicy:
This platform uses the following cookies and storage technologies:

• Strictly necessary storage: your language and accessibility preference, and the configuration/admin session (sessionStorage). No personal data is saved in the browser without your consent.

• Local storage (localStorage) and IndexedDB: temporarily store the invitation content (texts, images, and AES-GCM encrypted audio) so that it loads faster and is available offline. Only used if you accept storage; if you reject it, the invitation is displayed in session mode (without persistence) and saved data is deleted.

• Third-party services (only after your consent): Google Analytics and Sentry (statistics and error diagnosis). Sentry session replay records the session only if you accept analytics and does not record your credentials.

• On-demand actions (without prior consent, by your click): Google Maps to display the invitation map and the Google translation widget. Using them sends your data to those services according to their own policies.

• Service worker: caches the static resources necessary for the app to work offline, without personal data.

You can configure or withdraw your consent at any time from the cookie notice. Duration: necessary for the stated purposes (invitation data is deleted 12 months after the wedding or sooner if requested).

decoration-sway.hint: Ganyen zane a gefe kan suna rawa laushi, kamar an motsa su da ruwan sama, yayin da duk gayyata.

decoration-float.name: Faɗuwa da ganyen
decoration-float.hint: Motsi na tsayi mai laushi na ganyen zane yayin da kake cikin sashi.

story-transitions.name: Canjin tsakanin sassa
story-transitions.hint: Lokacin da kake sarrafa (scroll), kowane sashi yana rashin bayyane, yana motsi kuma yana canza ƙarfin haske bisa yadda yake kusa ko nesa da tsakiyar allo.

story-reveal.name: Shigo na 3D na takarda yayin shigo
story-reveal.hint: Lokacin da a buɗe kuskuren sako, farkon sashi yana shigo da kwaikwayo na 3D ƙarami da rashin bayyane da ke raguwa.

story-smooth-scroll.name: Sarrafa laushi
story-smooth-scroll.hint: Motsi tsakanin sassa yana ɗauke da ƙarfi laushi maimakon faɗuwa.

story-snap.name: Tsaro-tsaro na sassa
story-snap.hint: Lokacin da ka tsaya da sarrafa kusa da sashi, gayyata na kansa yana shigo don tsakenta a allo.

story-hover.name: Tashi na sashi lokacin da aka wuce mouse
story-hover.hint: Sashi na aiki yana ɗaga kaɗan da saro lokacin da ka wuce mouse.

fireflies.name: Samar da dazzalin ƙarami
fireflies.hint: Dazzalin ƙarami 20 tare da haɗin haske suna motsawa a hankali a saniyar allo.

music-equalizer.name: Barrar equalizer
music-equalizer.hint: Barrar uku suna motsawa kamar equalizer a maɓallin waƙa yayin da waƙar ke rawa.

music-fab-pulse.name: Dabewar maɓallin waƙa
music-fab-pulse.hint: Haɗin ƙaramin haske yana juya maɓallin waƙa mai faɗuwa yayin da ake kunna.

music-card-open.name: Apertura wa abikin (Opening the player)
music-card-open.hint: Allurarin manhajar na kiɗan zai bayyana da ƙarfi lokacin da aka danna maɓallan. (The music player panel unfolds with a soft scale when the button is pressed.)

music-icon-bounce.name: Buguwar alamar kiɗa (Music icon bounce)
music-icon-bounce.hint: Alamar ƙaratu tana bugawa lokacin buɗe ko rufe abikin kiɗa. (The musical note icon bounces when opening or closing the player.)

music-fab-shift.name: Canjin maɓallan kiɗa (Music button shift)
music-fab-shift.hint: Maɓallan da ke ɓoye yana canza zuwa gefe lokacin buɗe abikin kiɗa don kada ya taɓa shi. (The floating button shifts to the side when opening the player so as not to cover it.)

music-dot-blink.name: Maƙallan sanarwa na kiɗa (Music notification point)
music-dot-blink.hint: Maƙallan da ke nuna kuskure ko yanayin sauti suna kurkura da laushi. (The point that notifies of an error or audio status blinks softly.)

music-play-glow.name: Hala na maɓallan yin kiɗa (Play button halo)
music-play-glow.hint: Maɓallan yin kiɗa ko tsaya na abikin kiɗa yana fitar da haɗi wanda ke kurkura da laushi. (The play or pause button of the player emits a halo that pulses softly.)

music-spinner.name: Gudun ɗaukar kiɗa (Music loading wheel)
music-spinner.hint: Gudun yana motsawa a kan maɓallan yayin da ake ɗaukar waƙa. (A wheel spins on the button while the song is loading.)

music-fab-hover.name: Canjin maɓallan kiɗa (Music button scale)
music-fab-hover.hint: Maɓallan da ke ɓoye yana girma kaɗan lokacin da aka wuce ma'anar hannu. (The floating button enlarges slightly when hovering over it.)

music-status-shake.name: Tafiyar kuskuren kiɗa (Music error shake)
music-status-shake.hint: Sako na kuskuren ɗaukar kiɗa yana rawa don jawo hankali. (The loading error message shakes to draw attention.)

hero-photo-ring.name: Hala mai zinariya na hoto (Photo golden halo)
hero-photo-ring.hint: Hala mai zinariya yana kurkura a kowace hoto ta jodi a shafin. (A golden halo pulses around the couple's photo on the cover.)

hero-godparent-glow.name: Hala na ƴan uwan (Best man halo)
hero-godparent-glow.hint: Rubutun da ke ɗauke da sunayen ƴan uwan yana fitar da haɗi mai zafi wanda ke kurkura. (The text with the best men's names emits a warm halo that pulses.)

hero-photo-fade.name: Fadawa na hoto lokacin da ake ɗaukar (Photo fade on load)
hero-photo-fade.hint: Hoto na shafin yana bayyana da fade mai laushi lokacin da ya gama ɗaukar. (The cover photo appears with a soft fade when finished loading.)

countdown-tick.name: Sana'ar adadin lokaci (Live countdown)
countdown-tick.hint: Lissafin lokaci da ke rage yana sabunta kowace sani. Lokacin da aka tafi da shi, ana nuna ƙima ta farko ta daka. (The remaining time counter updates every second. When deactivated, the initial static value is shown.)

loading-spinner.name: Gudun ɗaukar kiɗa (Loading wheels)
loading-spinner.hint: Gudun da ke motsawa waɗanda ke bayyana yayin da ake ɗaukar hoto na shafin da sauran abubuwa. (The spinning wheels that appear while loading the cover photo and other contents.)

gallery-blur.name: Canjin hoto tare da rashin bayani (Photo change with blur)
gallery-blur.hint: Lokacin da ake bincike na gallari, hoton da ya gabata yana rawa yayin da wanda sabon ke shigo da haske. (When navigating the gallery, the previous photo blurs while the new one enters sharply.)

gallery-caption.name: Shigo da bayanin kowane hoto (Photo description entry)
gallery-caption.hint: Bayanan kowane hoto suna bayyana tare da ƙaramin tashi zuwa sama. (The description of each photo appears with a small slide up.)

gallery-lightbox.name: Bude maƙallan hoto (Photo viewer open)
gallery-lightbox.hint: Maƙallan gallari na allon hoto mai sifa yana bayyana tare da fade na shigo. (The full-screen gallery viewer appears with an entrance fade.)

gallery-thumb-hover.name: Canjin ƙaramin hoto (Thumbnail scale)
gallery-thumb-hover.hint: Ƙaramin hoton gallari suna girma kaɗan lokacin da aka wuce ma'anar hannu. (The gallery thumbnails enlarge slightly when hovering over them.)

gallery-nav-hover.name: Canjin ƙaramin abubuwa na gallari (Gallery arrow scale)
gallery-nav-hover.hint: Maɓallan shiri na gallari suna girma lokacin da aka wuce ma'anar hannu. (The gallery navigation arrows enlarge when hovering over them.)

gallery-auto-advance.name: Canjin gallari na kansa (Automatic carousel advance)
gallery-auto-advance.hint: Gallari tana wucewa daga hoto zuwa hoto kowace sani biyu. Lokacin da aka tafi da shi, tana canza ne kawai lokacin da aka danna maɓallan. (The gallery advances from photo to photo every 5 seconds. When deactivated, it only changes when the arrows are pressed.)

button-hover.name: Tashi na maɓallan (Button elevation)
button-hover.hint: Maɓallan gayyace (confirm attendance, share, send...) suna tashi kaɗan tare da bayyana lokacin da aka wuce ma'anar hannu. (The invitation buttons (confirm attendance, share, send...) lift slightly with a shadow when hovering over them.)

reaction-hover.name: Canjin maɓallan motsa (Reaction scale)
reaction-hover.hint: Maɓallan motsa (❤️ 🎉 😂) suna girma kaɗan lokacin da aka wuce ma'anar hannu. (The reaction buttons (❤️ 🎉 😂) enlarge slightly when hovering over them.)

theme-glow-depth.name: Hala na baya (Background glow)
theme-glow-depth.hint: Hala mai haske yana tafiya a hankali a kan baya na gayyace yana ba da yanayin zurfi. (A glow of light slowly traverses the background of the invitation giving a sense of depth.)

landing-pulse.name: Kurkuran allon ɗaukar (Loading screen pulse)
landing-pulse.hint: Bayan baya na allon ɗaukar, kuskure, da kuma yiwuwa yana kurkura da laushi. (The background of the loading, error, and maintenance screens pulses softly.)

toast-animations.name: Sanarwar da ke ɓoye (Floating notifications)
toast-animations.hint: Sanarwar ƙarancin (confirmations, errors...) suna bayyana da ɓoyewa tare da tashi. (The brief notifications (confirmations, errors...) appear and disappear with a slide.)

animations.allOffLabel: Tafi da duk hanyoyin haɗawa (Disable all animations)
animations.allOffHint: Lokacin da aka kunna, gayyace yana bayyana ba tare da wata hanyar haɗawa ba: ba a bayyana kwando ba, babu ƙarefi ko canji. Lokacin da aka tafi da shi, suna da sabbin sirri na kai. (When activated, the invitation is shown without any animation: the envelope does not appear, there is no confetti or transitions. When deactivated, your individual preferences return.)
animations.allOffActive: Anakan fusata saboda da tsarin gaba.
